thread:
Lena M.: Heads-up: VertexAI Labs (acct 905) March invoice missing metering line for 'hot-cache reads' causing invoice to be 
~$2,300 higher vs portal. Can someone sanity-check?

metering-bot: metering-collector job 2026-08-14T09:02:12Z completed with 1 WARN: rate-limited partitions detected for account 905. job id met_20260814_0902

Owen R.: Which invoice id?

Lena M.: INV-2026-03-0905 (raw: s3://billing-outputs/2026/03/INV-2026-03-0905.json). PDF shows no 'hot-cache read' lines.

Priyanka (Acct): I see two invoice drafts in system: INV-2026-03-0905 and INV-2026-03-0905-ALT. Both Draft, autopay off. Please hold and do not capture.

Owen R.: Pulled the metering logs. The collector returned 429 for the hot-cache read metric for a 20m window and the aggregator skips windows with partial data. Bug: it treats partial windows as complete rather than triggering re-ingest.

Owen R.: Problem fragment: if (window.isPartial) { proceed(); } // should mark for retry

Priyanka (Acct): Put holds on both drafts and create provisional credit so CS can show something: $2,300.00 reason "missing hot-cache reads".

billing-bot: invoice_hold applied on INV-2026-03-0905 by Priyanka at 2026-08-14T09:18:01Z

billing-bot: provisional_credit created PC-2026-08-0041 $2,300.00 linked to INV-2026-03-0905 and INV-2026-03-0905-ALT

Owen R.: Opening PR to treat partial windows as retryable and to surface rate-limit alerts: https://git.internal.redwood/metering-collector/pulls/61. Requesting quick deploy to staging.

Lena M.: While eng works, please also add an internal note and create FIN ticket.

billing-bot: finance-ops ticket FIN-5233 created "VertexAI Labs missing hot-cache reads due to metering rate-limit" assigned to Billing Ops

Owen R.: Deployed fix to prod, triggered re-ingest for account 905 only and re-ran billing reprocess:

billing-reprocess --account 905 --period 2026-03 --mode regenerate --reason "metering partial window retry"

billing-bot: job_reproc_905_202603 completed at 2026-08-14T10:12:34Z. Result: regenerated invoice uploaded s3://billing-outputs/2026/03/INV-2026-03-0905-corrected.pdf. Duplicate draft INV-2026-03-0905-ALT voided.

Priyanka (Acct): Verified corrected invoice, converted provisional credit PC-2026-08-0041 to official credit memo CM-2026-08-0023 and applied. Notified customer via CS.

Lena M.: Thanks team. Postmortem items for FIN-5233: add rate-limit monitoring on metering collector, require re-ingest on partial windows, and add invoice delta alert > $500. :thumbsup:
